content.comment_body: Hello, I'm working with [product_name] and need more workspace in my network project. I've searched online but can't find a method to add another network diagram or expand the workspace for a clearer program layout. Is there any solution for this?
[IMAGE] Click this button to open a window where you can set the number of horizontal and vertical pages you want.
Thanks! I'd been looking for something like "Add new diagram" but it turns out this button was what I needed. Even though I missed it, your advice was really helpful!

analysis.insight_summary: The user struggled to locate features for expanding the workspace in [company_name] software. The option to add more pages or diagrams was not clearly marked, but assistance clarified that a certain button allows adjustment of horizontal and vertical pages. This points to a user interface issue with accessing workspace expansion tools.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects an easy, clearly labeled option to add extra network diagrams or increase page space, making programs easier to read and organize.
